THE EDIFERA PHILOSOPHY

CONSTRUCTION IS MORE THAN CONCRETE.
It's planning. It's people. It's precision. It's responsibility.

01 / PLANNING

Engineered Rigor

Structural modeling, pre-construction feasibility, and risk mitigation long before breaking ground.

02 / PEOPLE

Skilled Workforce

Seasoned civil engineers, post-tensioning specialists, and safety directors united by craft.

03 / PRECISION

Uncompromising Quality

Strict material testing, laser tolerances, and continuous quality audits at every structural lift.

04 / RESPONSIBILITY

Absolute Ownership

Complete transparency, guaranteed timeline delivery, and lifetime structural integrity.

EDIFERA INFRATECH PVT. LTD. is a fast-growing construction and infrastructure firm headquartered in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). Specializing in RCC superstructures, industrial PEB systems, post-tensioned slabs, and commercial infrastructure, we combine deep engineering expertise with seamless execution.

OUR MISSION

"To deliver construction projects with precision, transparency, and uncompromising quality."

Elevating conventional construction into a disciplined engineering science, ensuring every RCC beam, steel joint, and post-tensioned tendon meets rigorous structural safety standards.

OUR VISION

"To create lasting spaces that shape communities and stand the test of time."

Becoming Maharashtra's most trusted structural execution partner, recognized for pioneering modern building technologies and enduring infrastructure legacies.

ABOUT EDIFERA INFRATECH

BUILDING WITH PURPOSE. DELIVERING WITH PRECISION.

EDIFERA INFRATECH PVT. LTD. is a fast-growing construction company dedicated to delivering excellence in every project. Operating since 2019 and incorporated in 2025, we specialize in RCC structures, industrial PEB systems, post-tensioned slabs, residential, commercial, and infrastructure developments.

Our head office is proudly located in CSN (Aurangabad). We combine deep engineering expertise, a skilled technical team, and robust project management practices to create structures that stand the test of time.

Company Overview

  • Headquarters: CSN (Aurangabad), Maharashtra
  • Establishment: Trust Since 2019 • Incorporated 2025
  • Core Specialization: High-Rise RCC, PEB Steel, PT Slabs
  • Regional Footprint: Maharashtra & Western India
  • Quality Standards: ISO Compliant Execution & Safety Integrity
